facts.business: Manoj Ceramic Limited is engaged in the wholesale, retail, distribution, marketing, and export of wall and floor tiles, artificial marbles, composite marbles, quartz stones, natural marble, natural granite, tiles adhesive, sanitary ware, and faucets, and has expanded its objects to include architectural, interior designing, and engineering services.
key_risks: Concentration Risk in Revenue: approximately 70% of total sales made to three major customers

Advance Payments to Creditors and Related Trade Receivables: advances to creditors aggregating to ₹10031.21 Lakhs, of which ₹5590.54 Lakhs given to parties with whom the Company also undertakes sale of goods transactions
